subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Technology follows rules humans create.”?
options: The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
It was evidence that water remembers low places, even when people build new roads over them.
Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
If the values are unclear, the machine's action may be wrong even when the code works perfectly.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It was evidence that water remembers low places, even when people build new roads over them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Technology follows rules humans create. If the values are unclear, the machine's action may be wrong even when the code works perfectly.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
